fundamental.summary: CLX shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 20 days create near-term uncertainty.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (295.2) combined with recent CPI miss and imminent earnings in 20 days creates hostile trading environment for CLX despite normal yield curve.
